summary: Perfect Corp. filed a Form 6-K announcing an extraordinary general meeting (EGM) scheduled for October 19, 2026, to approve a merger agreement dated July 10, 2026. Under the agreement, Merger Sub, ProjectNY, a Cayman Islands entity controlled by Chairwoman and CEO Alice H. Chang, will merge with and into Perfect Corp., with the company surviving as a privately held entity. The board, acting on the unanimous recommendation of a special committee of independent directors, recommends shareholder approval. The EGM record date is September 8, 2026. This represents a going-private transaction led by management, pending shareholder vote.
